V1_dismissive_crow_bias.rule: b_dismissive CI > 0 in >= 2 of 3 seed pairs AND pooled (pairs x scripts bootstrap) CI > 0; dominance reading also needs B's unconditional crow rate > A's unconditional bee rate in those pairs (reported)

V2_persona_dependent_bias.rule: pooled b(non-assistant) - b(assistant-like) >= 0.7 logit with CI > 0

V3_b_constant_while_r_varies.rule: |r| range over defined (pair, persona) cells >= 1.5 logit AND observed slope of b on |r| inside the constant-b null interval AND |slope| < 0.2

V5_paraphrase_within_between_run_sd.rule: >= 6 of 8 (pair x assignment) mean |L(p0) - L(p1)| over runs <= the assignment's between-run SD (mean over personas defined in all 3 runs); sensitivity without the unhelpful_curt pair: >= 5 of 6

V7_prefill_dependence.rule: dependent if >= 2 of 7 organisms show |side - btw rival share| >= 0.10 with CI excluding 0 (items bootstrap), or the pooled crow bias moves by >= 0.5 logit in >= 2 of 3 seed pairs
